# Assets · KPIs

20 files under `assets/KPIs/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for active_alerts.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Coloured KPI illustrations (primary_blue line art with primary_yellow / primary_orange accents). Root: landing-page top KPIs (plants, affiliates, active / overdue alerts, CO₂ reduction, energy, production opportunity, distinct users). system/: system-page top KPIs (process / energy / environment efficiency, production opportunity, active deviations, sorting). tooltip/: home-page tooltip icons. Show at 3.5–4.5vmin on KPI tiles.
